migration_note: An item with NO tlp label is quarantined. To publish unlabelled content from a collector whose source material is public by nature (e.g. a government vulnerability catalogue), the operator must review it and add an entry {"source": <exact lower-case source id>, "hosts": [<hostnames that collector publishes from>]} to first_party_public_sources in a reviewed commit. Both must match: the item's source id AND the host of its source URL, so feed-supplied text alone cannot self-approve. The effective label of an aggregated dossier is the most restrictive of its own and its included sources' labels. Such items are published with an explicit 'policy-assigned' marker; an item that carries ANY explicit label is never policy-assigned, and an invalid label is never assignable. TLP:WHITE (TLP v1) stays quarantined until the operator sets legacy_white_treated_as_clear=true after reviewing the affected items.
